summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to maintain essential broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries. The text urges protecting E-Rate to ensure connectivity for students and supports preserving the program rather than reducing its role.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase operational costs for school districts
claims.evidence_quote: Maintaining connectivity requires investments in routers, fiber lines, servers, and cyber security are all vital to our school but also increasing in cost every day
